description: A flowchart diagram file (flowchart_en.eddx from the EdrawMax template library) is already open in Wondershare EdrawMax. The diagram shows a flowchart on a single page labeled 'Page-1' visible in the page tabs at the bottom of the canvas. Your task is: (1) Add a new page to this document by clicking the '+' button next to the page tabs at the bottom of the canvas, or by right-clicking a page tab and selecting 'Insert Page'. (2) Rename the new page from its default name to 'Notes' by double-clicking the new page tab and typing 'Notes'. (3) On this new Notes page, insert a text box (use Insert > Text Box or the Text tool in the toolbar) and type the text 'This diagram shows the standard flowchart process'. (4) Save the file using Ctrl+S. The file is /home/ga/multipage_diagram.eddx. Note: if an account login dialog appears, close it with the X button in the dialog's top-right corner before proceeding.
